info.name: Bookstore Inventory API
info.description: Bookstore inventory backend (Django 5 + DRF). Base URL has no /api prefix. Variables: baseUrl (http://localhost:8000) and bookId (id of an existing book).

item.name: Books
item.description: Book resource: CRUD plus the optional search and low-stock endpoints. All list endpoints return {count, next, previous, results}.

request.description: 201 Created with the full book representation (id, created_at, updated_at, selling_price_local=null). Invalid payloads return 400 with DRF field errors, e.g. {"cost_usd": ["Ensure this value is greater than or equal to 0.01."]} or {"isbn": ["A book with this ISBN already exists."]}.
200 {count, next, previous, results}. page_size is capped at 100 and defaults to the PAGE_SIZE setting (10). An empty page parameter falls back to the first page.
200 with the book, or 404 {"detail": "No Book matches the given query."}.
200 with the updated book. 400 for rule violations (including an ISBN already used by another book) and 404 for an unknown id.
204 No Content, or 404 for an unknown id.
200 with the paginated envelope. The category match is case-insensitive; omitting category returns the whole catalogue.
200 with every book whose stock_quantity <= threshold (inclusive). threshold defaults to 10; a non-numeric or negative threshold returns 400 {"threshold": ["..."]}.

item.name: Price calculation
item.description: External integration: current USD -> local currency rate plus the configured profit margin, persisted on the book.

request.description:
Calculates cost_local = round_half_up(cost_usd * exchange_rate), selling_price_local = round_half_up(cost_usd * exchange_rate * (1 + margin/100)) with margin 40%, persists selling_price_local and returns:

{
  "book_id": 1,
  "cost_usd": 15.99,
  "exchange_rate": 0.85,
  "cost_local": 13.59,
  "margin_percentage": 40,
  "selling_price_local": 19.03,
  "currency": "EUR",
  "calculation_timestamp": "2025-01-15T10:30:00Z",
  "exchange_rate_source": "live"
}

exchange_rate_source is "live" on success and "fallback" when the FX provider failed and EXCHANGE_FALLBACK_ENABLED is true. A failed provider with the fallback disabled returns 503 {"detail": "The USD to EUR exchange rate is currently unavailable. Please try again later."}; an unknown book id returns 404; GET/PUT/PATCH/DELETE return 405.
